description: The annual birthday trip to Lee's, Dalwhinnie. I feel like the story for this one is permanently written ahead of time. A lot of beer, some interesting interaction, and hills. We had a bit of an unexpected welcome this time actually, which is always welcome, of course. We'd already got a couple of crates in for the intended big night on Saturday, after Gettin' Freaky In Ardverikie II. But after dinner on the Friday, we sat down with a couple of old boys for, what we thought would be a boot them out of the room sort of situation, but ended up being yet another lesson in drinking, life, and Munros. These guys were cookie cutter Gigachads. We finihsed up around 5am to some Live Aid, 2 shot bullets worth of crate, and a completely polished bottle of Speyburn 15. How else to celebrate a divorce, eh? And, the oldest boy was up for keeping the night going. Only two complaints the next day, so could have been worse. We actually didn't rise until after midday on the Saturday, which never happens to us. We only managed another round of The Fara. A very difficult round, for reasons which cannot be discussed. Also not like us. After that, I'm sure you guessed it, it was more getting messed up, Ferris, then Casino.
